method: Deterministic replay of two actual native extractions and explicitly constructed boundary traces. No new model response, no game events, no rewrite of the failed play record.
guard_categories: False or hidden intermediate checkpoint rejects even when endpoints agree.
Known negative predicate can carry; absence/redaction does not establish negation.
True reversed actions still reject at distinct or equal prose offsets.
Historical/reported/conditional modes stay out of actual-state scope; uncertain remains unsupported.
limitations: No new successful playthrough or retroactive commit.
Model claim extraction and temporal classification remain probabilistic.
Ambiguous ordering among multiple action claims is not solved by this static-state rule.
